title: 小学
description: 适合 5-10 岁、刚开始接触英语的孩子。全部取自 The Fable Cottage 的美式发音版本，都是伊索寓言式的经典小故事：语速慢、句型重复、情节靠画面就能懂。篇幅从 2 分钟到 6 分钟递进，词汇和句子长度也随之增加。
descriptionEn: For children aged 5-10 who are just starting English. All stories come from The Fable Cottage in US English accent — Aesop-style fables told slowly, with repeated sentence patterns and plots you can follow from the pictures alone. Length increases from 2 to 6 minutes, and so do vocabulary and sentence length.

items.episode: The Girl and the Ice Cream Truck
items.englishName: The Girl and the Ice Cream Truck (US English accent)
items.description: 最短的一集。围绕冰淇淋车展开，句子极短，适合作为听力起步。
items.descriptionEn: The shortest episode, built around an ice cream truck. Very short lines — a good starting point for listening practice.

items.englishName: The Dog and his Bone (US English accent)
items.description: 狗叼着骨头过河，看见水里的倒影以为有另一只狗。讲贪心的经典寓言，动词多为动作描写。
items.descriptionEn: A dog crossing a river mistakes his own reflection for another dog with a bigger bone. A classic fable about greed, told mostly through action verbs.

items.description: 一棵橡树的四季与生长。自然类名词和季节表达较多。
items.descriptionEn: An oak tree through the seasons. Rich in nature nouns and seasonal expressions.

items.englishName: The Fox and the Crow (US English accent)
items.description: 狐狸用夸奖骗走乌鸦嘴里的奶酪。对话为主，出现赞美和比较的句型。
items.descriptionEn: A fox flatters a crow out of her cheese. Dialogue-driven, with compliments and comparatives.

items.englishName: The Wind and the Sun (US English accent)
items.description: 风和太阳比赛谁能先让旅人脱下外套。含比较级与「谁更强」的表达。
items.descriptionEn: The wind and the sun compete to make a traveller take off his coat. Contains comparatives and 'who is stronger' phrasing.

items.description: 一头狮子被小动物吓到。情绪词丰富，出现 frightened、scared 等表达。
items.descriptionEn: A lion gets scared by smaller animals. Emotion-heavy vocabulary — frightened, scared and similar words.

items.englishName: The Bear and the Bee (US English accent)
items.description: 熊想吃到蜂蜜。动物与食物名词较多，情节有反复。
items.descriptionEn: A bear tries to get honey. Plenty of animal and food vocabulary, with a repeating plot structure.

items.episode: The City Mouse and the Country Mouse
items.englishName: The City Mouse and the Country Mouse (US English accent)
items.description: 乡下老鼠进城做客。城乡对比的词汇，句式比前几集更长。
items.descriptionEn: A country mouse visits the city. City-versus-country vocabulary, with longer sentences than earlier episodes.

items.englishName: The Bird and the Whale (US English accent)
items.description: 小鸟和鲸鱼的跨物种友谊。篇幅较长，出现描述情感与距离的语句。
items.descriptionEn: A friendship between a small bird and a whale. Longer in length, with sentences describing feelings and distance.

items.englishName: The Little Red Hen (US English accent)
items.description: 小红母鸡种麦子、磨面粉、烤面包，别的动物都不肯帮忙。步骤描述多，反复用 will you help me 句型。
items.descriptionEn: The little red hen plants wheat, mills flour and bakes bread while the other animals refuse to help. Lots of step-by-step description, with the repeated pattern 'will you help me'.
